rdfs:label: Invalidation
rdfs:comment: A qualified PROV invalidation — the start of the destruction, cessation, or expiry of an Entity by an Activity, after which the Entity is no longer available for use.
notes: End-of-life counterpart to `urn:solid:Generation`. Use to qualify `prov:wasInvalidatedBy` with `urn:solid:atTime` and other context. Linked from an Entity via `prov:qualifiedInvalidation`. In ActivityStreams the closest analogues are `urn:solid:Delete` (the activity) and `urn:solid:Tombstone` (the placeholder left behind).

examples.title: Qualified invalidation of a deleted post

history.note: Comment covers expiry/cessation, not just ceasing to exist; Tombstone reframed as placeholder; seeAlso additions.
